name: org.abcommunity/abcommunity
title: ABCommunity
description: Find the right MCPs, tools and skills for any AI task - discovery over a 25k+ resource catalog.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search ABCommunity's curated catalog of 25,000+ AI resources: MCP servers, Agent Skills, tools, frameworks, courses, guides and more. Use it for keyword or topic lookups ('postgres', 'browser automation', 'MCP course'). For a goal described in a sentence, prefer find_mcp_for_task. Every filter is strict (results never include other types or unverified items when you ask for verified). Each result has a match label, why it matched, an English and Azerbaijani description, its ABCommunity page and source/repository URL. Page through results with offset/nextOffset. Call get_catalog_overview to see valid capability keys, categories and counts.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'postgres', 'pdf to markdown', 'github mcp'. Omit to browse by filters only.

resource_type.description: Restrict to one type (or a comma-separated list): skill, mcp, tool, framework, course, guide, docs, cookbook, template, starter, boilerplate, prompt, workflow, repository, model, api, dataset, eval, benchmark, design_resource (aliases like 'mcp-server' or 'library' are accepted)

capabilities.description: Capability keys the resource must provide, e.g. ['email.read','project.task.create']. See get_catalog_overview.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. agents, ai-coding, data-rag, devops-infra, learning, security, automation

platform.description: Client the resource is recorded as compatible with, e.g. claude-code. Data is sparse; if nothing matches, results are returned without it and a note says so.

pricing.description: Only resources with this pricing model

deployment.description: MCP servers only: hosted endpoint (remote) or runs on your machine (local)

open_source.description: true = only open-source, false = only closed-source

official.description: Only resources published by the vendor/maintainer itself

offset.description: Skip this many results (use nextOffset from the previous call)

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

tools.name: find_mcp_for_task
tools.description: Describe in plain language what you want your AI to do. ABCommunity detects the capabilities the task needs (e.g. read email, create task), searches MCP servers, and returns recommendations chosen so each need is covered, plus alternatives, with reasons, links and install availability. Example: 'I want my AI to read Gmail and create Linear tasks.' Next steps: get_installation for setup, compare_mcps to choose between options.

task.description: Natural-language goal. Name the services and actions, e.g. 'query Postgres and post a summary to Slack'

platform.description: Target client, e.g. claude-code, cursor, vscode

deployment_preference.description: Prefer hosted (remote) or on-machine (local) servers; soft preference

open_source_preference.description: Prefer open-source servers (soft preference, not a hard filter)

security_preference.description: Security preference, e.g. 'read-only', 'no local execution', 'official only'

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: For a multi-step workflow, recommend the smallest set of MCP servers that covers every detected capability, each one's role, and the order (read inputs, process, write outputs). Extra MCPs are never added for padding, and any capability left uncovered is reported. Example: 'monitor GitHub pull requests and notify the team on Slack'.

task.description: The workflow to accomplish, naming services and actions

platform.description: Target client, e.g. claude-code, cursor, vscode

deployment_preference.description: Prefer hosted (remote) or on-machine (local) servers; soft preference

open_source_preference.description: Prefer open-source servers (soft preference, not a hard filter)

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Return complete structured metadata for one resource: descriptions (EN/AZ), capabilities, tools, transports, auth, packages, compatibility, pricing, security profile, quality signals (stars, last commit), installation and links. Accepts a slug, numeric id, exact name, ABCommunity page URL or GitHub 'owner/repo'. If nothing matches, the error lists the closest slugs.

slug.description: Slug, exact name, ABCommunity URL or GitHub owner/repo, e.g. 'github-github-mcp-server' or 'github/github-mcp-server'

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

tools.name: compare_mcps
tools.description: Factual side-by-side comparison of two to five resources (usually MCP servers) across capabilities, pricing, auth, deployment, maintenance, compatibility, open-source status, GitHub stars and tool count. No subjective winner is chosen. Accepts slugs, ids, names or GitHub owner/repo; unknown references are listed with suggestions.

refs.description: Slugs, ids, names or GitHub owner/repo to compare

tools.name: get_installation
tools.description: Return the recorded installation method(s), a ready-to-paste MCP client config (built only from the recorded endpoint or package), package info, transports, auth requirements and source references for a resource. Never fabricates commands: if nothing is recorded, it says so and points to the repository/docs. Accepts a slug, id, name or GitHub owner/repo.

resource.description: Slug, id, name or GitHub owner/repo of the resource

client.description: Target client for a client-specific method, e.g. claude-code, cursor

tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: List what the ABCommunity catalog contains and the exact values its filters accept: resource types with counts, categories, the capability taxonomy (keys such as email.read, database.query, browser.automate with access type and risk), platforms, pricing values and the most recently added resources. Call this first when you need valid capability keys or category slugs for search_resources.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Understand a project idea or repo summary and return product type, stack, stage, modules, risks, and open questions.

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

repo_url.description: Public repository URL, used as context only (it is not cloned or executed)

repo_snapshot.description: Optional summary of the repo, e.g. {files:[...], package_json:{...}, readme:'...'}

goals.description: Product or delivery goals, e.g. ['launch MVP', 'add billing']

constraints.description: Limits to respect, e.g. ['no paid APIs', 'EU data residency']

tools.name: plan_project_sprints
tools.description: Break a project into execution-ready sprints with tasks, acceptance criteria, risks, and next actions.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

team_size.description: Number of people working on it

sprint_length.description: Length of one sprint, e.g. '1 week' or '2 weeks'

tools.name: map_resources_to_project
tools.description: Explain which ABCommunity resources apply to a project, when to use them, how to apply them, and what config/risk is involved.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

limit.description: Maximum number of resources to return (1-20)

tools.name: recommend_resources_for_sprint
tools.description: Recommend MCPs, skills, tools, APIs, and frameworks for one sprint in a project roadmap.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

sprint_id.description: Sprint id from plan_project_sprints, e.g. 'foundation'; omit for the current most relevant sprint

limit.description: Maximum number of resources to return (1-20)

tools.name: generate_agent_blueprint
tools.description: Create role-specific agent instructions for a project sprint or area.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

sprint.description: Sprint id or name the agent works on

resources.description: Resource slugs the agent may use (from search or map tools)

tools.name: generate_config_bundle
tools.description: Create safe client-specific MCP config notes, env checklist, install steps, and verification steps for selected resources.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack

selected_resources.description: Resource slugs to include in the config bundle (from search or map tools)

client.description: Client to format the config for (default generic)

tools.name: get_next_project_action
tools.description: Return the next most useful action for a project based on its sprint roadmap and current state.

project_context.description: Output of analyze_project (or any object with project_description, goals, stack); pass it to keep later tools consistent

project_description.description: Plain-language project brief: what it does, for whom, main features and stack
